name: @ayerselectronics/lancelot

tools.name: lancedb_search
tools.description: Search LanceDB for relevant documents using vector or text search

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default: the configured limit, 20; at most 200)

searchType.description: vector uses OpenAI embeddings, text matches words in the text column, auto uses vector when a key is set and text otherwise

table.description: Table to search (default: the configured table)

tools.name: lancedb_query
tools.description: RAG query with context retrieval from LanceDB

contextBudget.description: Maximum characters of context to return (default: the configured budget, 8000)

warmStart.description: Retrieve a general project overview instead of answering the question

table.description: Table to query (default: the configured table)

limit.description: Maximum number of chunks to retrieve (default: the configured limit, 20; at most 200)

verbose.description: Include the column names of each table
